gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies {@link AmPm#get(java.time.temporal.TemporalField)} behaviour when queried with a field that an am-pm value does not support.
ADDED i2: An am-pm only supports the AMPM_OF_DAY field, so requesting an unrelated calendar field such as MONTH_OF_YEAR must be rejected.
